title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 135 Main Street in Biloxi, Mississippi, as the Robert S. McKeithen Post Office Building.
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 135 Main Street in Biloxi, Mississippi, as the Robert S. McKeithen Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Postal Service building in Biloxi, Mississippi, after Robert S. McKeithen.
summary.what_it_does: This act names the United States Postal Service facility at 135 Main Street in Biloxi, Mississippi, the Robert S. McKeithen Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or how the building operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 19, 2022, and the renaming took effect on that date.
